newsitem.title: USA: SBC takes steps to offer Okla. long-distance.
newsitem.headline: SBC takes steps to offer Okla. long-distance.

text.p: SBC Communications Inc's Southwestern Bell, Oklahoma's largest local telecommunications services provider, said Wednesday it filed documents with the Oklahoma Corporation Commission that could lead to full long-distance competition throughout the state.
The documents Southwestern Bell filed with the commission offer general terms and conditions that would be available to all potential local competitors in Oklahoma.
The utility said it believes the terms satisfy the provisions outlined in the federal Telecommunications Act of 1996 to open its local markets to competitors.
